title: Hook
narration: Du weißt, dass du anfangen solltest – und trotzdem öffnest du plötzlich TikTok, räumst den Tisch auf oder machst irgendetwas anderes.
visualIdea: One large fully visible classic countryball-style character with the same bold two-tone surface as the cover stands beside one important faceless task while a generic short-video phone, snack and tiny side task pull attention from the opposite side; no desk hides the ball and the white countryball eyes are the only facial feature.
audioCue: Du weißt, dass du anfangen solltest

imagePhases.rationale: Primary visual moment for the scene; strong enough to establish the scene's main idea.

title: Nicht einfach Faulheit
narration: Das wirkt wie Faulheit, ist aber oft eher ein Problem der Selbstregulation.
visualIdea: A neutral sphere is caught between an important task and a turbulent emotion cloud, showing self-regulation rather than a lazy character stereotype.

imagePhases.visualIdea: A neutral sphere is caught between an important task and a turbulent emotion cloud, showing self-regulation rather than a lazy character stereotype.
imagePhases.rationale: Primary visual moment for the scene; strong enough to establish the scene's main idea.

title: Unangenehme Aufgaben
narration: Besonders Aufgaben, die langweilig, schwierig, unklar oder unangenehm wirken, werden leichter aufgeschoben.
visualIdea: A large task block looms over a neutral sphere with visual cues for boredom, difficulty, uncertainty and anxiety.

imagePhases.visualIdea: A large task block looms over a neutral sphere with visual cues for boredom, difficulty, uncertainty and anxiety.
imagePhases.rationale: Primary visual moment for the scene; strong enough to establish the scene's main idea.

imagePhases.visualIdea: Zoom into the task itself as four faceless visual cues show boredom, difficulty, uncertainty and emotional discomfort without turning icons into characters.
imagePhases.rationale: Second visual beat adds a distinct explanatory step and prevents an overlong still without adding a quota image.

title: Sofortige Erleichterung
narration: Dein Gehirn bekommt durch Ablenkung sofort eine kleine Erleichterung.
visualIdea: The sphere turns from the unpleasant task toward a quick distraction and its tense expression visibly relaxes for a moment.

imagePhases.visualIdea: The sphere turns from the unpleasant task toward a quick generic distraction and its tense expression visibly relaxes for a moment.
imagePhases.rationale: Primary visual moment for the scene; strong enough to establish the scene's main idea.

imagePhases.visualIdea: Close editorial view of the sphere with a small mood gauge moving from tense to relieved while the unfinished task stays blurred behind it.
imagePhases.rationale: Second visual beat adds a distinct explanatory step and prevents an overlong still without adding a quota image.

title: Stress wird verschoben
narration: Die eigentliche Aufgabe bleibt jedoch liegen – und der spätere Stress wächst.
visualIdea: The unfinished task remains untouched while a future stress pile grows larger behind the sphere like stacked papers and a rising pressure gauge.

imagePhases.visualIdea: The unfinished task remains untouched while a future stress pile grows larger behind the sphere like stacked papers and a rising pressure gauge.
imagePhases.rationale: Primary visual moment for the scene; strong enough to establish the scene's main idea.

title: Kurzfristig gegen langfristig
narration: Genau deshalb fühlt sich Aufschieben kurzfristig gut und langfristig schlecht an.
visualIdea: A split timeline contrasts immediate relief on the left with a larger stressful unfinished task on the right.

imagePhases.visualIdea: A split timeline contrasts immediate relief on the left with a larger stressful unfinished task on the right.
imagePhases.rationale: Primary visual moment for the scene; strong enough to establish the scene's main idea.

title: Was Prokrastination begünstigt
narration: Forschung verbindet Prokrastination außerdem mit Impulsivität, geringer Selbstwirksamkeit und weit entfernten Belohnungen.
visualIdea: A neutral sphere is pulled toward a bright instant distraction while looking uncertainly at a difficult task and a distant reward.

imagePhases.visualIdea: A neutral sphere is pulled toward a bright instant distraction while looking uncertainly at a difficult task.
imagePhases.rationale: Primary visual moment for the scene; strong enough to establish the scene's main idea.

imagePhases.visualIdea: The same sphere sees a meaningful reward far in the distance beyond a long path, while an easy pleasant alternative sits close in the foreground.
imagePhases.rationale: Second visual beat adds a distinct explanatory step and prevents an overlong still without adding a quota image.

title: Die Gegenwart gewinnt
narration: Je später die Konsequenz kommt, desto leichter gewinnt die angenehme Alternative im Moment.
visualIdea: A perspective scene makes the immediate pleasant option large and close while the future consequence appears small and far away.

imagePhases.visualIdea: Perspective makes the immediate pleasant option large and close while the future consequence appears small and far away.
imagePhases.rationale: Primary visual moment for the scene; strong enough to establish the scene's main idea.

imagePhases.visualIdea: A clean balance-scale metaphor tips toward the immediate pleasant option because it is visually closer and heavier than the distant future consequence.
imagePhases.rationale: Second visual beat adds a distinct explanatory step and prevents an overlong still without adding a quota image.

title: Disziplin allein
narration: Deshalb reicht „Ich muss disziplinierter sein“ oft nicht.
visualIdea: A determined neutral sphere pushes against an oversized task wall while a small mood cloud remains unresolved behind it.

imagePhases.visualIdea: A determined neutral sphere pushes against an oversized task wall while a small mood cloud remains unresolved behind it.
imagePhases.rationale: Primary visual moment for the scene; strong enough to establish the scene's main idea.

title: Den Start verkleinern
narration: Hilfreicher ist, den Start konkret und klein zu machen.
visualIdea: A huge intimidating task is broken into one tiny highlighted first tile directly in front of the sphere.

imagePhases.visualIdea: A huge intimidating task is broken into one tiny highlighted first tile directly in front of the sphere.
imagePhases.rationale: Primary visual moment for the scene; strong enough to establish the scene's main idea.

title: Vage gegen konkret
narration: Nicht: „Ich lerne heute.“ Sondern: „Um 19 Uhr öffne ich das Dokument und arbeite fünf Minuten an Aufgabe eins.“
visualIdea: A vague floating plan hovers above a neutral sphere without a clear start point.

imagePhases.visualIdea: A vague floating plan hovers above a neutral sphere without a clear time, location or first action.
imagePhases.rationale: Primary visual moment for the scene; strong enough to establish the scene's main idea.

imagePhases.visualIdea: The vague plan transforms into a simple concrete three-part start plan: clock at 19:00, open document, five-minute first task block.
imagePhases.rationale: Second visual beat adds a distinct explanatory step and prevents an overlong still without adding a quota image.

title: Prüffrage
narration: Frag dich beim nächsten Aufschieben: Welche unangenehme Stimmung vermeide ich gerade?
visualIdea: The neutral sphere pauses between the task and several emotion clouds, deliberately looking at the feeling it has been avoiding.

imagePhases.visualIdea: The neutral sphere pauses between the task and several emotion clouds, deliberately looking at the feeling it has been avoiding.
imagePhases.rationale: Primary visual moment for the scene; strong enough to establish the scene's main idea.

title: Abschluss
narration: Dann mach nur den kleinsten klaren ersten Schritt. Du musst nicht die ganze Aufgabe schaffen – nur anfangen.
visualIdea: The sphere takes one small illuminated first step toward a much larger staircase-sized task, while the rest remains intentionally out of focus.

imagePhases.visualIdea: The sphere takes one small illuminated first step toward a much larger staircase-sized task, while the rest remains intentionally out of focus.
